title: Catalent and Mantra™ Announce Commercial Supply Agreement for Single-Serve Oral Gel Portfolio
llm_note: Catalent signed a commercial supply agreement to provide manufacturing and packaging for Mantra's oral gel platform.

title: Par Health recalls more IV bags on cellulose risk weeks after similar action
llm_note: Par Health issued a voluntary recall of two lots of IV bags due to potential cellulose contamination.

title: Americhem Opens New Clean Compounding Facility in Suzhou, China

title: GSK to invest $800M for new R&D, manufacturing hub in Pennsylvania
llm_note: GSK is investing $800 million to build a new manufacturing hub in Pennsylvania starting in 2027.
